phase: 0.9.1-rc.3 — Fixes the two defects that made the rc.2 public download unusable for a new user. First, every published instruction told the user to Control-click and choose Open to get past Gatekeeper; Apple removed that override in macOS 15 Sequoia, so on macOS 15 and later the app silently never opened and no working path was documented. The site, install steps and first-run guide now lead with System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway. Second, the DMG window layout is generated deterministically by dmgbuild (ds_store/mac_alias) instead of by driving the Finder over AppleScript. The old pass needed an Automation/TCC grant, and when that was missing it only warned — so rc.2 shipped with no .DS_Store at all: no background, no icon placement, three loose licence files on the volume. Packaging is now reproducible in a non-interactive shell and in CI, verified by Scripts/test-dmg-headless.sh with the Finder quit and a clean clone, and asserted by Scripts/test-dmg-layout.sh. The DMG background is redrawn on the site's paper/ink/cobalt palette. Still unsigned and not notarized: no Apple Developer identity exists, so Gatekeeper will still block the first launch and that is expected, not a defect. legalReviewStatus remains 'pending' and the COREXTEND trademark watch item is unresolved, so no trademark clearance is claimed.
